messages:
tess_employment: hi team — submitting an ADA accommodation request. i have a chronic autoimmune condition with unpredictable flare-ups (extreme fatigue, brain fog). doc recommends a flexible schedule, predictable meeting windows, and exemption from rotating on-call during flare periods. filing intake now.

dana_hr: thanks for flagging, @tess_employment. case opened HR-2026-321. @omar_manager @facilities_ops @lee_legal looping in to coordinate temporary mitigations.

omar_manager: Tess thanks for telling us. for immediate support, please take the rest of today off and we can set a temporary schedule (core hours 10–3) and shift your on-call rotations for the next 30 days. i'll check with the team about coverage.

tess_employment: appreciate it. core hours sound good. for longer-term i may need predictable days remote and limit to 1 long meeting per day.

accom-bot: HR case HR-2026-321 created: "Episodic illness — flexible schedule/on-call exemption." Intake requested.

oncall-bot: Alert: Tess is scheduled for on-call week starting 1775120000. Manager Omar to confirm substitution by EOD.

omar_manager: noted @oncall-bot — i'll swap Tess's on-call with Priya for that week. PR to scheduling repo: https://git.internal/schedules/replace?user=tess_employment&with=priya_engineer

lee_legal: quick note: document what options are offered and Tess's selected preference. do not condition accommodation on future performance. if performance concerns exist, address separately with documented coaching.

dana_hr: @tess_employment please complete the confidential intake form: https://hr.redwood.example/intake?case=HR-2026-321 or request a private call. after intake HR will draft an accommodation agreement within 3 business days.

facilities_ops: tagging workspace — we can reserve a quieter desk near filtered ventilation and ship an ergonomic keyboard/monitor riser if helpful. let us know preferred office days and we'll reserve accordingly.

omar_manager: small aside — there have been recurring timeliness issues raised in past 1:1s. i want to support you, Tess, but also need to ensure deliverables land. HR/legal: how should we proceed so support and performance tracking don't conflict?

lee_legal: manager may continue to track objective performance metrics and coaching plans. keep those records separate from medical docs. do not tie accommodation approvals to current or future disciplinary action.

dana_hr: next steps summary: 1) Tess completes intake or schedules call; 2) manager arranges immediate schedule/on-call swaps; 3) facilities reserves quiet desk/equipment; 4) HR drafts accommodation agreement (target 3 business days). HR will log agreed measures in HR-2026-321.

tess_employment: i'll fill intake tonight. thanks everyone for moving quickly. would prefer the 10–3 core and on-call exemption for 30 days to start.

omar_manager: confirmed — reserving schedule and swapping on-call. i'll follow up 1:1 tomorrow about deliverables and supports.

dana_hr: thanks all 44d please DM any medical attachments rather than posting here. closing public thread once agreement signed in HR case HR-2026-321."
